description: Regression tests made from three_play runs, kept in the project as .threesmith/scenarios/<name>.json (commit them; threesmith ci runs them and writes JUnit). op save runs the play once more with the same arguments and keeps it only when it passes (undoable with three_undo); op list shows the kept ones; op run runs one (name) or all, with every failing claim, its value and frame.

expect.description: Claims about the scene: "$('player').position.y > 1 @ end", "any: $('door').rotation.y > 1", "always: info.render.calls < 200", "x @ step 2", or {js, at}.

name.description: scenario name (letters, digits, - and _); for run: exact or part of the name

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

name: three_scenario
title: Keep and run regression scenarios
